title: hi, i'm sarah
subtitle: Sarah Novotny on open source, trust and the politics of technology. Writing, a bio and how to get in touch.

posts.title: Your Tools Don’t Have a Reputation
posts.description: Transitive trust is how collaborative software actually works. Alice vouches for Bob, Bob vouches for Carol. When you put your name on generated code you extend that trust to something which cannot earn it back.

posts.title: Open Source Misconceptions Debunked for Government
posts.description: Open source is free the way a puppy is free. What governments misunderstand about that is a set of reasonable inferences from a procurement worldview built for a different kind of thing.
